content: The test image shows soybean leaves with white powdery/fluffy patches scattered across the leaf surface. Leaves are otherwise green. This strongly suggests Powdery Mildew. Let me verify with reference images across 4 classes.

Soybean rust reference shows brown/tan dried-out plants — nothing like the test image.

**Analysis:**
- Test image: green soybean leaves with white powdery patches on the upper leaf surface, scattered across multiple leaves — classic powdery mildew presentation
- Powdery Mildew reference (Soybean_Dise_20): identical appearance — white powdery coating on leaf surfaces
- Downy mildew reference: shows yellow spots, sporulation on underside — different pattern
- Soybean rust: brown/dead plant tissue — clearly different

The white powdery patches on the adaxial (upper) leaf surface is the hallmark symptom of Powdery Mildew.
